title: Beautiful blue soft fleece blanket
text: Beautiful blue soft fleece blanket. Super soft fleece blanket. I fold it and keep it over my family room couch and use it to drape it over myself when I am feeling cold. It is soft and pill free and is so comfortable. It looks super attractive, too, with a vibrant blue color. Of course, others may want to use this as a bed blanket, but as my bed is king size, this is far better used as an oversized throw. I absolutely love this.

product_metadata.title: Flannel Fleece Throw Blanket - 300GSM All Season Throw 50" x 60" Super Soft Cozy Plush Couch Sofa Throw, Office Lap, Travel Camping Blanket, Grey
features: 🏠 VERSATILE THROW BLANKET : Surrounded in comfort and warmth with our soft fleece throw blanket while cuddling up for a quick nap, settling in for a restful night's sleep or snuggling on sofa for your favorite TV show. Drape it over couch or chair for an inviting look or unfold it at the end of your bed for decoration and dust-proof use

🏠 DURABLE & COZY BLANKET : Made of sleek fleece, the cozy blanket brings with a soft touch. It’s durable and won’t fray after long time washing and remains vibrant color. Lint-free, fade-resistant and static-restrained

🏠 ALL SEASON PORTABLE THROW : The breathable one layer throw blanket is in moderate thickness and weight. Not too thermal nor too flimsy. Practical to use year around no matter to snuggle in summer night or drape over in winter. Modest size (50" x 60") is portable and compact to carry for camping, traveling, picnic and so on
🏠 MACHINE WASH & EASY CARE : This durable blanket needs effortless care. Its modest size allows being placed into a common washer. Tumble dry in gentle setting, do not use detergent

🏠 SOPHISCATED FOR HOME DECOR : The sleek microfiber is wrinkle-resistant and not tend to bunch. It’s decent luster delivers a sophisticated look which easily complements with your room in elegant vibe
